aodn/portalSync/enabled: Push metadata changes to the portal
aodn/portalSync/enabled-help:
Trigger: every metadata a harvester saves -> GenericEntityListener -> this switch -> es-indexer.
  • Enabled: every metadata save or delete is pushed to the portal index via es-indexer.
  • Disabled: nothing is pushed, the portal index only changes through a full reindex.
Stored in the database with the other settings, so it survives Fargate restarts. A fresh database starts disabled. POST /setup disables it when it loads harvesters. It is not re-enabled automatically: once harvesting and a full reindex are done, tick this box or call POST /srv/api/site/settings.
